reader.requirement: At --std 85 a COMPUTE with several identifier-1 must develop the expression's value once (before any receiver is stored) and then store that one value into each identifier-1 left to right as a sequence of separate stores (§1985:VI.6.4.6), each with its own ROUNDED and size-error test, a receiver's subscript being identified at its own store.
reader.edition-search: EmitCompute's multi-target arm (Snapshot then per-receiver GuardedStore) has no edition test; grep for DialectBehavior|DialectLevel in ArithmeticEmitter.cs finds only EmitArith.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: one value stored into each receiver at both editions
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf02_02 covers A B = A + 1 and one value into differing shapes with ROUNDED; not exercised: a receiver subscripted by an earlier receiver, a size error in one receiver with others stored, an operand used twice with a receiver alias

probes.expected: I = 3, then TE (3) = 3 identified after I is stored (§1985:VI.6.4.6 (2): a sequence of statements in left-to-right order)

probes.printed: M2 0.7  0.66 [  0.6] (COMPUTE C ROUNDED D E = 2 / 3); M4 15 015 (COMPUTE A B = A * 2 + A, A = 5)
probes.expected: one value 0.666..: 9V9 ROUNDED 0.7, S9V99 0.66, ZZ9.9 0.6; the value 15 developed once and stored in both

probes.printed: M3 SIZE 11 150 (COMPUTE A B = 150 ON SIZE ERROR, A PIC 99 = 11, B PIC 999)
probes.expected: A unchanged (11), B stored 150, the ON SIZE ERROR imperative runs (§1985:VI.6.4.2)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.8.4 GR2  (║6.8.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: With more than one receiver EmitCompute materializes the value once (Snapshot) and stores it per receiver inside its own GuardedStore, so an alias or a subscript that a prior receiver changed cannot alter the value; the probes printed the required results.

refuter.evidence: rcomp.cob X10: COMPUTE I TE (I) = I + 1 with I = 1 -> I 2, TE(1) 00, TE(2) 02, TE(3) 00: the value developed once from the initial I, the receiver's subscript identified at its own store after I is stored (§1985:VI.6.4.6). X11: COMPUTE R1 R3 = -12.5 -> -12.50 and 012 (one value, each receiver's own sign rule). X15: COMPUTE R3 MX = 1000 with no phrase, R3 PIC 999 overflowing -> MX 000000000000001000 stored, control continues. rcnot.cob Y1: COMPUTE A B = 150 with only NOT ON SIZE ERROR, A PIC 99 overflowing -> B 150, NOT phrase not executed. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.8.4 GR2 the text is in GR2; OK §1985:VI.6.4.6 the text is in the clause; it lies in GR2.
